The terms of the settlement were also recorded in our order.
In this application, being MA No. 1431 of 2024 filed by the respondent husband, a request is made for quashing of case no. 250 of 2022 as well as Complaint Case No. 50 of 2022.
In this application, we have also heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner wife.
It is commonly agreed by both the parties that they have decided to seek quashing of the above referred Criminal Cases.

In view of the above, we allow Miscellaneous Application No. 1431 of 2024 and quash the proceedings in Case No.250/2022 arising out of FIR No.370 of 2021 registered at Police Station-Lal Kuan,
